notes.title: NEXT FEST, NEW FRIENDS, AND EVEN MORE SLIPPERY ADVENTURES
notes.notes: [h3][b]Hello, beloved penguins! It’s your host Alican again![/b][/h3][p]Since our first devlog last month, things have been incredibly lively! We joined Steam Next Fest and showcased our demo for the very first time. Huge thanks for your amazing support and the thousands of new wishlists! Our Discord community has been rapidly growing with your participation, and thanks to your fantastic feedback, we've continued improving the game every single day. (Of course, I might have spent a lot of time "testing" by sliding around and slapping my teammates, but let’s keep that between us! 😊) Now, let’s dive into some exciting updates we've made since the demo![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Snowboards are Here. Penguins Just Got Cooler![/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597481/cb33d2e44387745e625162337c2e86e796e61eb8.gif"][/img][/p][p]Penguins can finally snowboard! We now have an alternative to painfully sliding on our bellies. You can grab a snowboard from the in-game shop and glide stylishly down the slopes with acrobatic moves. Of course, slapping me instead of sliding is still an option. 😊[/p][p][/p][h3][b]More Colors, More Vibrant Penguins[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597481/6e23f1c7a3d143939c8e16e5db22a54d8409b388.gif"][/img][/p][p]We’ve added 20 brand new colors to character customization! Now everyone can make their penguins even more unique. Pink penguins, green penguins, even overly bright orange penguins are now possible! If you’d like to debate which color penguin deserves the most slaps, let me know in the comments. 😊[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Brand New Inventory and Camera System[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597481/ab397c2818d3e72ac5642998e8306c14c71aa545.gif"][/img][/p][p]Our in-game inventory interface has been completely revamped. Everything is now much cleaner and easier to use. The camera has also been redesigned from scratch—make sure to take plenty of photos and share them on Discord! A special slap from me awaits the penguin with the best pose![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Additional Improvements and Much More[/b][/h3][p]We've fixed numerous minor bugs, optimized performance, and made the gameplay experience smoother than ever. Now when you pause the game, your sliding penguin stops respectfully too. Your mouse cursor no longer disappears, your camera won’t get stuck, and overall, everything is a lot more enjoyable.[/p][p]We've removed minigames to make the game experience more focused. You can now also cancel fishing anytime you want. Say goodbye to the days of endlessly waiting for fish![/p][p]Due to popular demand, we've introduced some mysterious new drinks. Try them if you’d like your penguins to feel a little tipsy! (Careful—if you spin too much, penguins might topple over!) Additionally, we’ve added a Patreon button to the main menu, so you can now easily support the game if you wish.[/p][p]Lastly, thanks once again to everyone who supported us during Steam Next Fest, shared their feedback, and joined our fun! The game is getting better every day, all thanks to you.[/p][p]How have you been lately? Don’t forget to share your funniest moments with us![/p][p][/p][p]Much love,[/p][p]Alican 🐧❤️[/p]

notes.title: Small Fixes, Shiny Fish, and Global Penguins — Demo Update is Live!
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone! 🐧[/p][p]We just pushed a fresh update to the demo with a bunch of little improvements and fixes. Here’s what changed while we were definitely not just sliding around for fun:[/p][list][*][p]Valuable fish are now a bit harder to catch. Gotta earn those coins![/p][/*][*][p]There’s a new sign in the village that shows the names of all players. The Penguins at CO’s Entertainment 🐟[/p]

notes.title: COME AND JOIN US!
notes.notes: [p]Come and join us in this broadcast while the developers playing the game.[/p]

notes.title: STEAM NEXT FEST, SLIDING PENGUINS, AND A FEW SLAPS
notes.notes:
Hello, I’m your host Alican!

It has been a little over a month since we announced A Game About Penguins. During this time, we may have kept you in the dark a bit more than we should have, and for that, we sincerely apologize. However, I can confidently say we spent this period working hard to make the game better. (Okay, confession time: I actually spent a good portion of that time sliding around in the game and slapping our programmers under the name of “testing.” But let’s keep that between us! :))

First of all, I’m excited to share that we will be participating in the upcoming Steam Next Fest, which begins on June 9. This will be the first time we showcase our demo to players. Even though we have participated in a Steam festival and released a game before, the excitement still feels just as fresh for the whole team. While we may be experienced in launching games, the love and interest players from all around the world have shown toward A Game About Penguins is incredibly exciting. Now let me tell you about some of the updates we made over the past month.

[b]New Graphics[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597481/fe26f0a212d39fcc9f3683721eeec84a98b016ef.gif[/img]
As you can see in the GIF above, we completely overhauled the visuals of the game. We added more consistent lighting, trees that actually look like trees, and cozy little houses with chimneys puffing out smoke. I would love to hear what you think about these visual changes. Hopefully you like them. If not, feel free to slap me if you run into me in the game. :)

[b]Sliding Mechanic[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597481/a7d914b8f5116a89e6ff4fa9a689620e3303802b.gif[/img]
One of the features we really wanted to implement was this sliding mechanic. Berk and Enes from the team worked on it and did a fantastic job. It is genuinely fun to use. By the way, we are having a little debate in the team. Penguins in the game can slide uphill. I know that this is not physically possible, but at the end of the day this is a game, and in my opinion it is more fun this way. Berk disagrees because he says it breaks the laws of physics. Enes is undecided. What do you think? Let us know in the comments. Also, if you do not like the sliding mechanic, please slap Enes and Berk instead of me. :)

[b]Extra Improvements[/b]
Aside from these, we have been revisiting the entire UI, the online systems, and the core mechanics of the game. Our goal is to release the best possible version during Next Fest.

[b]Some Fun Coincidences[/b]
We announced the game on April 25, and we later found out that this is also World Penguin Day. We had no idea. It was not intentional, but it was a really sweet coincidence and gave the whole team a good laugh. Also, after sharing the game on social media, we received a few comments with GIFs from a game called “Penguin Adventure” which was released in 1986. Even though our game is titled A Game About Penguins, we had actually named the project folder “penguin adventure” when we started. That was another funny coincidence. Also, fun fact, Penguin Adventure was the first game that my favorite game developer Hideo Kojima worked on.

So that is how our month went. We are curious to hear what you think about the new stuff we added. And how has your month been? Feel free to share it with us. Also, do not forget to follow us on Discord, Instagram, Twitter or whatever platform you use.

With love,
Your host, Alican
